items.question: Trong câu "Ordered — not a flat list.", từ "flat" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ordered — not a flat list.", what does "flat" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: flat /flæt/ (tính từ): không phân thứ bậc. "A flat list" = danh sách ngang hàng, không có thứ tự ưu tiên; nghĩa đen là bằng phẳng.
items.explanationEn: flat /flæt/ (adjective): without ranking or order. "A flat list" has no ranking; literally "flat" means level and smooth.

items.question: Trong câu "Many items will never be built, and that is the CORRECT outcome because they were worth less than what was built.", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many items will never be built, and that is the CORRECT outcome because they were worth less than what was built.", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːθ/ (tính từ): có giá trị (bằng). "Be worth less than X" = có giá trị thấp hơn X. Cụm: be worth doing (đáng làm).
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːθ/ (adjective): having a value of. "Be worth less than X" means to have lower value than X. Collocation: be worth doing.

items.question: Trong câu "Also defects, technical work, research spikes, and technical debt", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also defects, technical work, research spikes, and technical debt", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. Danh từ /ˈdiːfekt/ = lỗi; động từ /dɪˈfekt/ = đào tẩu sang phe khác.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (noun): a fault or bug. Noun /ˈdiːfekt/ is a fault; verb /dɪˈfekt/ means to switch to the other side.

items.question: Trong câu "Also defects, technical work, research spikes, and technical debt", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also defects, technical work, research spikes, and technical debt", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): đợt nghiên cứu thử (ngắn). "Research spike" = hạng mục nghiên cứu ngắn để giảm bất định; "a spike in traffic" = lưu lượng tăng vọt.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a short time-boxed investigation. A "research spike" is a short investigation to reduce uncertainty; "a spike in traffic" is a sudden rise.

items.question: Trong câu "An unbounded backlog becomes useless — it needs periodic pruning", từ "unbounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An unbounded backlog becomes useless — it needs periodic pruning", what does "unbounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unbounded /ʌnˈbaʊndɪd/ (tính từ): không giới hạn. "An unbounded backlog" = backlog phình ra không giới hạn. Trái nghĩa: bounded (có giới hạn).
items.explanationEn: unbounded /ʌnˈbaʊndɪd/ (adjective): having no limit. "An unbounded backlog" grows without limit. Opposite: bounded.

items.question: Trong câu "An unbounded backlog becomes useless — it needs periodic pruning", từ "periodic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An unbounded backlog becomes useless — it needs periodic pruning", what does "periodic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: periodic /ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪk/ (tính từ): định kỳ. "Periodic pruning" = dọn dẹp định kỳ. Trạng từ: periodically. Cụm: periodic table (bảng tuần hoàn).
items.explanationEn: periodic /ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪk/ (adjective): happening at regular intervals. "Periodic pruning" happens at regular intervals. Adverb: periodically. Also: periodic table.

items.question: Trong câu "An unbounded backlog becomes useless — it needs periodic pruning", từ "pruning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An unbounded backlog becomes useless — it needs periodic pruning", what does "pruning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pruning /ˈpruːnɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc cắt tỉa, loại bớt. Nghĩa gốc là tỉa cành cây; với backlog = loại bớt các hạng mục không còn cần. Động từ: prune.
items.explanationEn: pruning /ˈpruːnɪŋ/ (noun): cutting away unneeded parts. Literally trimming a plant; for a backlog, removing items no longer needed. Verb: prune.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO is accountable, but the BA, team, and stakeholders all contribute", từ "contribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO is accountable, but the BA, team, and stakeholders all contribute", what does "contribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contribute /kənˈtrɪbjuːt/ (động từ): đóng góp. "Contribute to X" = đóng góp vào X. Danh từ: contribution, contributor.
items.explanationEn: contribute /kənˈtrɪbjuːt/ (verb): to give or add to. "Contribute to X" means to add your part. Nouns: contribution, contributor.

items.question: Trong câu "The single most important property.", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The single most important property.", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (danh từ): đặc tính. "A property of a healthy backlog" = một đặc tính của backlog tốt; nghĩa khác là tài sản, nhà đất.
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (noun): a characteristic quality. "A property of a healthy backlog" is a characteristic; the other sense is real estate.

items.question: Trong câu "An unordered backlog helps nobody.", từ "unordered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An unordered backlog helps nobody.", what does "unordered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unordered /ʌnˈɔːdəd/ (tính từ): không có thứ tự. "Unordered" = không sắp theo thứ tự ưu tiên. Trong CS: unordered set, unordered map.
items.explanationEn: unordered /ʌnˈɔːdəd/ (adjective): not arranged in sequence. "Unordered" means not arranged in sequence. In CS: unordered set, unordered map.

items.question: Trong câu "Items are added, removed, split, merged, and reordered throughout.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Items are added, removed, split, merged, and reordered throughout.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): tách ra. "Split an item" = tách hạng mục thành phần nhỏ hơn. Quá khứ vẫn là "split".
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split an item" means to divide it. The past form is also "split".

items.question: Trong câu "Items are added, removed, split, merged, and reordered throughout.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Items are added, removed, split, merged, and reordered throughout.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): gộp lại. "Merge items" = gộp các hạng mục trùng nhau. Quen thuộc trong Git: merge a branch.
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge items" means to combine them. Familiar in Git: merge a branch.

items.question: Trong câu "Items are added, removed, split, merged, and reordered throughout.", từ "throughout" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Items are added, removed, split, merged, and reordered throughout.", what does "throughout" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: all the time, from start to end
items.explanation: throughout /θruːˈaʊt/ (trạng từ): suốt (quá trình). "Throughout" đứng cuối câu = suốt cả quá trình. Làm giới từ: throughout the project.
items.explanationEn: throughout /θruːˈaʊt/ (adverb): all the time, from start to end. At the end of a sentence "throughout" means all along. As a preposition: throughout the project.

items.question: Trong câu "The most misunderstood property", từ "misunderstood" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most misunderstood property", what does "misunderstood" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstood /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstʊd/ (tính từ): bị hiểu sai. "The most misunderstood" = bị hiểu sai nhiều nhất. Động từ: misunderstand.
items.explanationEn: misunderstood /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstʊd/ (adjective): wrongly interpreted. "The most misunderstood" is the one people get wrong most. Verb: misunderstand.

items.question: Trong câu "In the MIDDLE: moderate, possibly still large.", từ "moderate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In the MIDDLE: moderate, possibly still large.", what does "moderate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: moderate /ˈmɒdərət/ (tính từ): vừa phải. "Moderate detail" = mức chi tiết vừa phải. Động từ /ˈmɒdəreɪt/ = điều phối (moderate a meeting).
items.explanationEn: moderate /ˈmɒdərət/ (adjective): medium in amount. "Moderate detail" is a medium level. Verb /ˈmɒdəreɪt/ means to chair (moderate a meeting).

items.question: Trong câu "At the BOTTOM: coarse, large, sometimes a single line.", từ "coarse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At the BOTTOM: coarse, large, sometimes a single line.", what does "coarse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: coarse /kɔːs/ (tính từ): sơ sài, thô. "Coarse-grained" = mức chi tiết thô; trái nghĩa: fine-grained. Đọc giống "course".
items.explanationEn: coarse /kɔːs/ (adjective): rough, not detailed. "Coarse-grained" means low detail; opposite: fine-grained. Pronounced like "course".

items.question: Trong câu "This is NOT sloppiness — it is efficiency.", từ "sloppiness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is NOT sloppiness — it is efficiency.", what does "sloppiness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sloppiness /ˈslɒpinəs/ (danh từ): sự cẩu thả. Tính từ: sloppy (cẩu thả, luộm thuộm). Cụm: sloppy code.
items.explanationEn: sloppiness /ˈslɒpinəs/ (noun): careless work. Adjective: sloppy. Collocation: sloppy code.

items.question: Trong câu "This is NOT sloppiness — it is efficiency.", từ "efficiency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is NOT sloppiness — it is efficiency.", what does "efficiency" (noun) mean?
options: sự hiệu quả, tiết kiệm công sức
items.explanation: efficiency /ɪˈfɪʃnsi/ (danh từ): sự hiệu quả, tiết kiệm công sức. "It is efficiency" = đó là cách làm hiệu quả, không lãng phí. Tính từ: efficient.
items.explanationEn: efficiency /ɪˈfɪʃnsi/ (noun): getting results without waste. "It is efficiency" means it avoids wasted effort. Adjective: efficient.

items.question: Trong câu "Detailing an item that will change or be dropped before its turn is pure waste.", từ "pure" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailing an item that will change or be dropped before its turn is pure waste.", what does "pure" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pure /pjʊə(r)/ (tính từ): hoàn toàn, thuần túy. "Pure waste" = hoàn toàn lãng phí; "pure water" = nước tinh khiết.
items.explanationEn: pure /pjʊə(r)/ (adjective): complete, nothing but. "Pure waste" means nothing but waste; "pure water" means clean water.

items.question: Trong câu "Detailing an item that will change or be dropped before its turn is pure waste.", từ "waste" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailing an item that will change or be dropped before its turn is pure waste.", what does "waste" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (danh từ): sự lãng phí. "A waste of time / effort" = sự lãng phí; "waste" còn là rác thải. Đừng nhầm "waist" (eo).
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (noun): a useless use of effort. "A waste of time / effort" is useless spending; "waste" can also be rubbish. Not "waist".

items.question: Trong câu "Everyone involved can see it and understand why the order is what it is.", từ "involved" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Everyone involved can see it and understand why the order is what it is.", what does "involved" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: involved /ɪnˈvɒlvd/ (tính từ): có liên quan, tham gia. "Everyone involved" = mọi người có liên quan; "an involved process" lại là quy trình rắc rối.
items.explanationEn: involved /ɪnˈvɒlvd/ (adjective): taking part. "Everyone involved" means all who take part; "an involved process" means a complicated one.

items.question: Trong câu "Refinement is the CONTINUOUS activity of preparing top-of-backlog items so they are ready for the next sprint.", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refinement is the CONTINUOUS activity of preparing top-of-backlog items so they are ready for the next sprint.", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (danh từ): sự tinh chỉnh, làm rõ. "Backlog refinement" = làm rõ, chi tiết hóa backlog; nghĩa khác: tinh luyện (dầu, đường), sự tao nhã.
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (noun): improving by adding detail. "Backlog refinement" means clarifying and detailing items; other senses: purifying, elegance.

items.question: Trong câu "Refinement is the CONTINUOUS activity of preparing top-of-backlog items so they are ready for the next sprint.", từ "continuous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refinement is the CONTINUOUS activity of preparing top-of-backlog items so they are ready for the next sprint.", what does "continuous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: continuous /kənˈtɪnjuəs/ (tính từ): liên tục. "A continuous activity" = hoạt động diễn ra liên tục. Cụm: continuous integration (CI).
items.explanationEn: continuous /kənˈtɪnjuəs/ (adjective): ongoing without stopping. "A continuous activity" never stops. Collocation: continuous integration.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarifying vague items by asking the PO and users.", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarifying vague items by asking the PO and users.", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarify requirements" = làm rõ yêu cầu. Danh từ: clarification.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarify requirements" means to make them clear. Noun: clarification.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarifying vague items by asking the PO and users.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarifying vague items by asking the PO and users.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ. "Vague items" = hạng mục mô tả mơ hồ. Trái nghĩa: clear, precise.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, imprecise. "Vague items" are unclearly described. Opposite: precise.

items.question: Trong câu "Who attends: the Product Owner, the BA, and at least some development team members — because they ask the questions that surface hidden work.", từ "attend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who attends: the Product Owner, the BA, and at least some development team members — because they ask the questions that surface hidden work.", what does "attend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attend /əˈtend/ (động từ): tham dự. "Attend a meeting" = tham dự cuộc họp (không có "to"). "Attend to" lại là chăm lo, xử lý.
items.explanationEn: attend /əˈtend/ (verb): to be present at. "Attend a meeting" means to be present (no "to"). "Attend to" means to deal with.

items.question: Trong câu "Who attends: the Product Owner, the BA, and at least some development team members — because they ask the questions that surface hidden work.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who attends: the Product Owner, the BA, and at least some development team members — because they ask the questions that surface hidden work.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to rise to the water top
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Surface hidden work" = làm lộ ra phần việc ẩn; danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to bring to attention. "Surface hidden work" means to reveal it; as a noun "surface" is the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Who attends: the Product Owner, the BA, and at least some development team members — because they ask the questions that surface hidden work.", từ "hidden" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who attends: the Product Owner, the BA, and at least some development team members — because they ask the questions that surface hidden work.", what does "hidden" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hidden /ˈhɪdn/ (tính từ): ẩn, chưa lộ ra. "Hidden work" = khối lượng việc ẩn chưa ai thấy. Động từ: hide – hid – hidden.
items.explanationEn: hidden /ˈhɪdn/ (adjective): not yet visible. "Hidden work" is effort nobody has noticed yet. Verb: hide – hid – hidden.

items.question: Trong câu "A practical rule: keep about TWO to THREE sprints of work in a ready state.", từ "practical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practical rule: keep about TWO to THREE sprints of work in a ready state.", what does "practical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: practical /ˈpræktɪkl/ (tính từ): thực tế, dễ áp dụng. "A practical rule" = quy tắc thực tế, dễ áp dụng. Trái nghĩa: theoretical.
items.explanationEn: practical /ˈpræktɪkl/ (adjective): useful in real situations. "A practical rule" works in real life. Opposite: theoretical.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequency: usually one or two sessions per sprint, each under an hour.", từ "frequency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequency: usually one or two sessions per sprint, each under an hour.", what does "frequency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rate of a radio wave
items.explanation: frequency /ˈfriːkwənsi/ (danh từ): tần suất. "Frequency" = tần suất (bao lâu một lần); trong vật lý là tần số. Tính từ: frequent.
items.explanationEn: frequency /ˈfriːkwənsi/ (noun): how often something happens. "Frequency" is how often; in physics it is wave rate. Adjective: frequent.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequency: usually one or two sessions per sprint, each under an hour.", từ "session" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequency: usually one or two sessions per sprint, each under an hour.", what does "session" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: session /ˈseʃn/ (danh từ): buổi làm việc. "Refinement session" = buổi refinement; trong web "session" là phiên đăng nhập.
items.explanationEn: session /ˈseʃn/ (noun): a meeting for one activity. A "refinement session" is one meeting for it; on the web a "session" is a login period.

items.question: Trong câu "Has no unresolved blocking dependency.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has no unresolved blocking dependency.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc. "Blocking dependency" = phụ thuộc chặn tiến độ (chờ đội khác, API...). Tính từ: dependent on.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): a reliance on something else. A "blocking dependency" is something you must wait for. Adjective: dependent on.

items.question: Trong câu "Has no unresolved blocking dependency.", từ "unresolved" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has no unresolved blocking dependency.", what does "unresolved" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unresolved /ˌʌnrɪˈzɒlvd/ (tính từ): chưa được giải quyết. "Unresolved issue" = vấn đề chưa xử lý xong. Động từ: resolve.
items.explanationEn: unresolved /ˌʌnrɪˈzɒlvd/ (adjective): not yet settled. "Unresolved issue" is still open. Verb: resolve.

items.question: Trong câu "Has identified test data if complex.", từ "identify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has identified test data if complex.", what does "identify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: identify /aɪˈdentɪfaɪ/ (động từ): xác định. "Identify test data" = xác định dữ liệu kiểm thử; "identify with someone" = đồng cảm với ai.
items.explanationEn: identify /aɪˈdentɪfaɪ/ (verb): to find and name. "Identify test data" means to find it; "identify with someone" means to feel close to them.

items.question: Trong câu "Has identified test data if complex.", từ "complex" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has identified test data if complex.", what does "complex" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complex /ˈkɒmpleks/ (tính từ): phức tạp. Tính từ "complex" = phức tạp; danh từ "a complex" = khu phức hợp hoặc mặc cảm.
items.explanationEn: complex /ˈkɒmpleks/ (adjective): having many parts. As an adjective "complex" means complicated; as a noun it is a group of buildings or a hang-up.

items.question: Trong câu "The definition of ready is a powerful team protection.", từ "protection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The definition of ready is a powerful team protection.", what does "protection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: protection /prəˈtekʃn/ (danh từ): sự bảo vệ. "Team protection" = tấm chắn bảo vệ đội. Động từ: protect.
items.explanationEn: protection /prəˈtekʃn/ (noun): a safeguard. "Team protection" is a safeguard for the team. Verb: protect.

items.question: Trong câu "objectively, rather than accepting a vague story and getting stuck mid-sprint.", từ "objectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "objectively, rather than accepting a vague story and getting stuck mid-sprint.", what does "objectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: objectively /əbˈdʒektɪvli/ (trạng từ): một cách khách quan. "Say no objectively" = từ chối dựa trên tiêu chí khách quan. Trái nghĩa: subjectively.
items.explanationEn: objectively /əbˈdʒektɪvli/ (adverb): based on facts, not feelings. "Say no objectively" means based on agreed criteria. Opposite: subjectively.

items.question: Trong câu "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", từ "beware" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", what does "beware" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beware /bɪˈweə(r)/ (động từ): cảnh giác với. "Beware (of) X" = hãy cảnh giác với X; thường dùng ở dạng mệnh lệnh. Ví dụ: beware of the dog.
items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweə(r)/ (verb): to be careful of. "Beware (of) X" means watch out for X; usually used as a command, e.g. beware of the dog.

items.question: Trong câu "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", từ "overly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", what does "overly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: overly /ˈəʊvəli/ (trạng từ): quá mức. "Overly strict" = quá khắt khe. Tương tự: too, excessively.
items.explanationEn: overly /ˈəʊvəli/ (adverb): too, excessively. "Overly strict" means too strict. Similar: excessively.

items.question: Trong câu "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", từ "strict" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", what does "strict" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: strict /strɪkt/ (tính từ): khắt khe, nghiêm ngặt. "Strict rules" = quy định nghiêm ngặt. Trong JS: strict mode.
items.explanationEn: strict /strɪkt/ (adjective): demanding exact obedience. "Strict rules" must be followed exactly. In JavaScript: strict mode.

items.question: Trong câu "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", từ "handoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But beware overuse: an overly strict definition of ready becomes a control gate that slows everything and recreates waterfall's document-handoff model.", what does "handoff" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: passing work to the next person
items.explanation: handoff /ˈhændɒf/ (danh từ): sự bàn giao. "Document handoff" = bàn giao qua tài liệu giữa các bước (kiểu waterfall). Cũng viết: hand-off, handover.
items.explanationEn: handoff /ˈhændɒf/ (noun): passing work to the next person. "Document handoff" is passing work on via documents between stages. Also: hand-off, handover.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep it short and focused on what genuinely blocks the team.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep it short and focused on what genuinely blocks the team.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (trạng từ): thực sự. "Genuinely blocks" = thực sự gây cản trở. Tính từ: genuine (thật, chân thành).
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (adverb): truly, really. "Genuinely blocks" means really stops progress. Adjective: genuine.

items.question: Trong câu "At 800 items nobody reads it all, searching becomes hopeless, and old items at the bottom merely create the illusion they will be built.", từ "hopeless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At 800 items nobody reads it all, searching becomes hopeless, and old items at the bottom merely create the illusion they will be built.", what does "hopeless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hopeless /ˈhəʊpləs/ (tính từ): vô vọng. "Searching becomes hopeless" = việc tìm kiếm trở nên vô vọng; "hopeless at maths" = rất dốt toán.
items.explanationEn: hopeless /ˈhəʊpləs/ (adjective): without any chance of success. "Searching becomes hopeless" means it cannot succeed; "hopeless at maths" means very bad at it.

items.question: Trong câu "At 800 items nobody reads it all, searching becomes hopeless, and old items at the bottom merely create the illusion they will be built.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At 800 items nobody reads it all, searching becomes hopeless, and old items at the bottom merely create the illusion they will be built.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪəli/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn thuần. "Merely create the illusion" = chỉ tạo ra ảo tưởng, không có ích gì hơn. Tính từ: mere.
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪəli/ (adverb): only, just. "Merely create the illusion" means they do nothing more than that. Adjective: mere.

items.question: Trong câu "At 800 items nobody reads it all, searching becomes hopeless, and old items at the bottom merely create the illusion they will be built.", từ "illusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At 800 items nobody reads it all, searching becomes hopeless, and old items at the bottom merely create the illusion they will be built.", what does "illusion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: illusion /ɪˈluːʒn/ (danh từ): ảo tưởng. "Create the illusion that ..." = tạo ảo tưởng rằng ... Đừng nhầm với "allusion" (sự ám chỉ).
items.explanationEn: illusion /ɪˈluːʒn/ (noun): a false belief. "Create the illusion that ..." means to make people falsely believe. Not to be confused with "allusion".

items.question: Trong câu "Three practices to keep it usable", từ "practice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three practices to keep it usable", what does "practice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: practice /ˈpræktɪs/ (danh từ): cách làm (thông lệ). "Practices" = các cách làm, thông lệ (best practices); nghĩa khác là luyện tập hoặc phòng khám.
items.explanationEn: practice /ˈpræktɪs/ (noun): an established way of working. "Practices" are ways of working (best practices); other senses are training or a clinic.

items.question: Trong câu "Three practices to keep it usable", từ "usable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three practices to keep it usable", what does "usable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: usable /ˈjuːzəbl/ (tính từ): dùng được. "Keep it usable" = giữ cho vẫn dùng được. Danh từ: usability (tính dễ dùng).
items.explanationEn: usable /ˈjuːzəbl/ (adjective): able to be used. "Keep it usable" means it stays practical to use. Noun: usability.

items.question: Trong câu "Prune periodically.", từ "prune" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prune periodically.", what does "prune" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cut back what is unneeded
items.explanation: prune /pruːn/ (động từ): loại bớt, cắt tỉa. "Prune the backlog" = cắt tỉa backlog; danh từ "prune" lại là quả mận khô.
items.explanationEn: prune /pruːn/ (verb): to cut back what is unneeded. "Prune the backlog" means to trim it; the noun "prune" is a dried plum.

items.question: Trong câu "Rejected ideas have a way of returning.", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rejected ideas have a way of returning.", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): bác bỏ. "Rejected ideas" = ý tưởng bị bác bỏ. Danh từ: rejection.
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to refuse to accept. "Rejected ideas" were turned down. Noun: rejection.

items.question: Trong câu "Rejected ideas have a way of returning.", từ "have a way of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rejected ideas have a way of returning.", what does "have a way of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: have a way of /hæv ə weɪ ɒv/ (cụm từ): hay có xu hướng. "X has a way of happening" = X hay có xu hướng xảy ra (thường ngoài ý muốn).
items.explanationEn: have a way of /hæv ə weɪ ɒv/ (phrase): to tend to happen. "X has a way of happening" means it tends to happen, often unexpectedly.

items.question: Trong câu "Keeping the decision and its rationale gives you the answer ready next time.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keeping the decision and its rationale gives you the answer ready next time.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do cơ sở. "The rationale for a decision" = lý do nền tảng của quyết định. Liên quan: rational (hợp lý).
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasons behind a decision. "The rationale for a decision" is the reasoning behind it. Related: rational.

items.question: Trong câu "That is far more honest than leaving it at the bottom forever creating false hope.", từ "honest" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is far more honest than leaving it at the bottom forever creating false hope.", what does "honest" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: honest /ˈɒnɪst/ (tính từ): trung thực, thẳng thắn. "Far more honest" = thẳng thắn hơn nhiều. Chữ "h" câm: /ˈɒnɪst/. Danh từ: honesty.
items.explanationEn: honest /ˈɒnɪst/ (adjective): truthful, frank. "Far more honest" means much more truthful. The "h" is silent. Noun: honesty.

items.question: Trong câu "That is far more honest than leaving it at the bottom forever creating false hope.", từ "false hope" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is far more honest than leaving it at the bottom forever creating false hope.", what does "false hope" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: false hope /fɔːls həʊp/ (cụm từ): hy vọng hão huyền. "Create / give false hope" = tạo hy vọng hão huyền cho ai.
items.explanationEn: false hope /fɔːls həʊp/ (phrase): hope with no real basis. "Create / give false hope" means making someone expect what will not happen.

items.question: Trong câu "Splitting it correctly is among the highest-value skills.", từ "among" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Splitting it correctly is among the highest-value skills.", what does "among" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: among /əˈmʌŋ/ (giới từ): nằm trong số. "Among the best" = nằm trong số tốt nhất. "Among" dùng cho nhóm nhiều, "between" cho hai đối tượng.
items.explanationEn: among /əˈmʌŋ/ (preposition): being one of a group. "Among the best" means one of the best. Use "among" for groups, "between" for two.

items.question: Trong câu "The WRONG way: by technical layer.", từ "layer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The WRONG way: by technical layer.", what does "layer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ (danh từ): tầng, lớp (kiến trúc). "Technical layer" = tầng kỹ thuật như UI, API, database. Cụm: layered architecture.
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ (noun): a level in a system. A "technical layer" is a tier such as UI, API or database. Collocation: layered architecture.

items.question: Trong câu "none delivers value on its own and none can be demonstrated at a sprint review.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "none delivers value on its own and none can be demonstrated at a sprint review.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdemənstreɪt/ (động từ): trình diễn, chứng minh. "Demonstrate at a sprint review" = demo cho mọi người xem; nghĩa khác là biểu tình.
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdemənstreɪt/ (verb): to show how something works. "Demonstrate at a sprint review" means to show it working; another sense is to protest publicly.

items.question: Trong câu "none delivers value on its own and none can be demonstrated at a sprint review.", từ "on its own" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "none delivers value on its own and none can be demonstrated at a sprint review.", what does "on its own" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on its own /ɒn ɪts əʊn/ (cụm từ): tự thân, một mình. "On its own" = tự nó, không cần phần khác. Tương tự: by itself.
items.explanationEn: on its own /ɒn ɪts əʊn/ (phrase): by itself, alone. "On its own" means without anything else. Similar: by itself.

items.question: Trong câu "Domestic orders first, international later", từ "domestic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domestic orders first, international later", what does "domestic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: domestic /dəˈmestɪk/ (tính từ): trong nước. "Domestic orders" = đơn hàng nội địa; "domestic work" = việc nhà.
items.explanationEn: domestic /dəˈmestɪk/ (adjective): within one country. "Domestic orders" are within the country; "domestic work" is housework.

items.question: Trong câu "Simple case first, exceptions later", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Simple case first, exceptions later", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a case that breaks the rule
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsepʃn/ (danh từ): trường hợp ngoại lệ. "Exceptions" ở đây = trường hợp ngoại lệ trong nghiệp vụ; trong lập trình còn là lỗi ném ra (throw an exception).
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsepʃn/ (noun): a case that breaks the rule. Here "exceptions" are business cases outside the rule; in programming an exception is a thrown error.

items.question: Trong câu "The overarching principle: every split story must be a thin VERTICAL SLICE — cutting through every technical layer for one real function.", từ "overarching" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The overarching principle: every split story must be a thin VERTICAL SLICE — cutting through every technical layer for one real function.", what does "overarching" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overarching /ˌəʊvərˈɑːtʃɪŋ/ (tính từ): bao trùm. "The overarching principle" = nguyên tắc bao trùm, chi phối mọi thứ khác.
items.explanationEn: overarching /ˌəʊvərˈɑːtʃɪŋ/ (adjective): covering everything. "The overarching principle" is the one that governs all the others.

items.question: Trong câu "The overarching principle: every split story must be a thin VERTICAL SLICE — cutting through every technical layer for one real function.", từ "slice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The overarching principle: every split story must be a thin VERTICAL SLICE — cutting through every technical layer for one real function.", what does "slice" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a piece of bread or cake
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (danh từ): lát cắt (xuyên các tầng). "Vertical slice" = lát cắt dọc xuyên qua UI, API, DB cho một chức năng; "a slice of pizza" = miếng pizza.
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (noun): a cut through all levels. A "vertical slice" cuts through UI, API and DB for one function; "a slice of pizza" is a piece.

items.question: Trong câu "This guarantees each story can be demonstrated and produces real feedback.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This guarantees each story can be demonstrated and produces real feedback.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo. "Guarantee that ..." = đảm bảo rằng ...; danh từ "a guarantee" còn là giấy bảo hành.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (verb): to make certain. "Guarantee that ..." means to make sure; the noun can also mean a warranty.

items.question: Trong câu "This guarantees each story can be demonstrated and produces real feedback.", từ "feedback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This guarantees each story can be demonstrated and produces real feedback.", what does "feedback" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: comments on how well something works
items.explanation: feedback /ˈfiːdbæk/ (danh từ): phản hồi, góp ý. "Real feedback" = phản hồi thực tế từ người dùng. Là danh từ không đếm được: some feedback.
items.explanationEn: feedback /ˈfiːdbæk/ (noun): comments on how well something works. "Real feedback" is genuine reaction from users. It is uncountable: some feedback.

items.question: Trong câu "Uneven detail is efficiency rather than sloppiness — detailing what will change is pure waste.", từ "uneven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uneven detail is efficiency rather than sloppiness — detailing what will change is pure waste.", what does "uneven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uneven /ʌnˈiːvn/ (tính từ): không đồng đều. "Uneven detail" = mức chi tiết không đồng đều. Trái nghĩa: even.
items.explanationEn: uneven /ʌnˈiːvn/ (adjective): not the same throughout. "Uneven detail" varies from place to place. Opposite: even.

items.question: Trong câu "Refinement running long signals you are detailing things too far away.", từ "signal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refinement running long signals you are detailing things too far away.", what does "signal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (động từ): cho thấy, báo hiệu. "X signals Y" = X là dấu hiệu cho thấy Y. Danh từ: a signal (tín hiệu).
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (verb): to indicate. "X signals Y" means X is a sign of Y. Noun: a signal.

items.question: Trong câu "Five right splits: process step, data type, user class, business rule, level of polish.", từ "polish" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Five right splits: process step, data type, user class, business rule, level of polish.", what does "polish" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: polish /ˈpɒlɪʃ/ (danh từ): độ trau chuốt. "Level of polish" = mức độ hoàn thiện, trau chuốt. "Polish" viết hoa lại là tiếng Ba Lan /ˈpəʊlɪʃ/.
items.explanationEn: polish /ˈpɒlɪʃ/ (noun): refinement and finish. "Level of polish" is how refined something is. Capitalised "Polish" /ˈpəʊlɪʃ/ is the language.

items.question: Trong câu "Order is the backlog's most important property, and decreasing detail from top to bottom is deliberate design.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Order is the backlog's most important property, and decreasing detail from top to bottom is deliberate design.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (tính từ): có chủ ý. Tính từ /dɪˈlɪbərət/ = có chủ ý; động từ /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ = cân nhắc kỹ.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (adjective): done on purpose. Adjective /dɪˈlɪbərət/ means intentional; verb /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ means to think carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "Splitting epics into thin vertical slices is the only way to guarantee every story is demonstrable and yields real feedback.", từ "demonstrable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Splitting epics into thin vertical slices is the only way to guarantee every story is demonstrable and yields real feedback.", what does "demonstrable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: demonstrable /dɪˈmɒnstrəbl/ (tính từ): có thể demo được. "Demonstrable" = có thể trình diễn/chứng minh được. Động từ: demonstrate.
items.explanationEn: demonstrable /dɪˈmɒnstrəbl/ (adjective): able to be shown working. "Demonstrable" means it can be shown or proved. Verb: demonstrate.

items.question: Trong câu "Splitting epics into thin vertical slices is the only way to guarantee every story is demonstrable and yields real feedback.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Splitting epics into thin vertical slices is the only way to guarantee every story is demonstrable and yields real feedback.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): mang lại. "Yield feedback / results" = mang lại phản hồi / kết quả; "yield to traffic" = nhường đường.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce, to give. "Yield feedback / results" means to produce them; "yield to traffic" means to give way.
